title: Abelian canonical covers of minimal rational surfaces and $\mathbb F_1$ up to degree $8$
summary: We classify abelian canonical covers of degree at most $8$ of smooth surfaces of minimal degree, and of $\mathbb P^2$ and Hirzebruch surfaces not embedded as surfaces of minimal degree. Let $π: X \longrightarrow W$ be an abelian canonical cover of a smooth surface of minimal degree $W$ with group $G$ and degree $n$.
